meta.notes: A classic race on the real Duval Street (playtest 3, T10.4; critic W1: the real world reaches the career; the maintainer, round 1: "Duval St"). It replaces Rental Return: the same first-tier slot, the same field and purse, a new place. Mallory Square's pier edge to the Southernmost Point buoy and back up Duval to the Gulf, at dusk, through the cruise-ship crowd, the pedicabs, the island tour tram and the roosters. Top 3 wins it; the optional bonus is $300 of style, since a crowded street is no place for a shortcut and Duval has none. The tier-one paces and cops of the Keys. [default] every number and name.
